text: Would you rather find out your partner has been cheating on you for a year, or find out they don't actually find you physically attractive?
Would you rather have a partner who is incredibly deeply in love with you but boring, or someone who is thrilling and fun but you know they might leave at any moment?
Would you rather your friend group secretly think you are annoying, or secretly think you are dumb?
Who is most likely to ruin a perfectly good moment by making it awkward?
Who is most likely to give terrible relationship advice but act like a professional therapist?
Who is most likely to stay in a toxic relationship just because the sex is good?
Never have I ever stalked an ex's new partner on social media from a fake account.
Never have I ever pretended to be texting someone when I was actually just avoiding a social interaction.
Never have I ever read a friend's private texts over their shoulder and kept it a secret.
Dating someone with zero ambition, or dating someone who works 80 hours a week and ignores you?
Getting back with your toxic ex, or staying single for the next 5 years?
Monogamy is inherently unnatural and humans force themselves into it because of societal pressure.
If you don't post your partner on social media, you are hiding them from someone or keeping your options open.
Men and women cannot be strictly platonic best friends without one of them catching feelings eventually.
Would you rather have a partner who is completely obsessed with you but slightly controlling, or completely hands-off but slightly emotionally distant?
Who is most likely to ghost someone after three great dates for absolutely no logical reason?
Who is most likely to get wildly successful but cut off their old friends?
Never have I ever lied about my body count.
Being in a sexless relationship with your soulmate, or being in a passionate relationship with someone you can't have a deep conversation with?
The 'talking stage' is just an excuse for commitment issues and shouldn't last longer than two weeks.
